items.title: U.S. strike on alleged drug boat kills 3 in Pacific Ocean, in fourth attack this week
items.description: The U.S. military said it carried out another strike on a boat accused of smuggling drugs in the Pacific Ocean, killing three in the fourth attack this week and putting the total death toll at 205.

items.title: Robot wars: Ukraine now adding ‘land drones’ to its futuristic arsenal
items.description: The Ukraine war has transformed the battlefield. First, it was aerial drones. Now, ground robots are being developed and deployed for reconnaissance, deliveries, evacuations, and handling mines. The goal: Help Ukraine stand up to its larger Russian enemy.

items.title: Ukraine: IAEA seeks access to Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant after reported drone strike
items.description: Russia claims that a Ukrainian drone struck the Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant. Ukraine has denied the accusation. The International Atomic Energy Agency has sought to examine the facility.

items.title: Putin's war fuels the growing role of Russia's FSB intelligence agency
items.description: The Federal Security Service (FSB), the KGB's successor and the agency that trained Vladimir Putin, has expanded its influence over Russia's military and political decision-making. From internet shutdowns to school propaganda and legal prosecution, its reach has extended across all of Russian society.

items.title: Gaza children trapped ‘in an endless cycle of suffering’: UNICEF
items.description: The dire conditions in the Gaza Strip are trapping children “in an endless cycle of suffering” and their heartbroken parents can only look on, an official with the UN child rights agency UNICEF said on Friday in a fresh appeal for greater humanitarian access to support families in the war-ravaged enclave.
